content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the JAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for JAU Senior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Junagadh Agricultural University (JAU) for filling up project assistant positions under agricultural research schemes.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in JAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Senior Project Assistant, offering candidates a temporary contractual opportunity in agricultural research departments.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Senior Project Assistant position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for JAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in, meaning eligible candidates can directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 12 October 2026. Candidates must report on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. (Agri.) degree in Plant Pathology or Genetics and Plant Breeding with First Class marks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government regulations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated fixed salary of Rs. 25,000 per month for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for JAU Senior Project Assistant?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test (MCQ) if the candidate count exceeds 10, followed by a personal interview.
